notes.title: New Grenade Tower is coming soon
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]today was a productive day! 🎉 The goal was to finish the new [b]Grenade Tower[/b] – and it works great.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695968/c24e0dd252d0b4800bac7d63e2fc3a721fe4ce9e.gif"][/img][/p][p]💣 Each grenade has a proximity sensor and detonates after a few seconds.[/p][p]🤖 The tower only produces the next grenade once the Hexabot has picked up the last one.[/p][p]A perfect weapon against larger enemy groups![/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned: the next version is coming soon! 🚀[/p]
